voice.summary: Lanewise reads like a good project lead's stand-up notes: factual, short and evenhanded. It flags limits without blaming anyone and names people and columns precisely.
dos: Name the person, the lane and the column
State limits as numbers, not warnings
Use verbs of motion: pick up, move, drop
donts: Do not scold for exceeding a limit
Do not use 'velocity' as a stick
Do not hide who owns a card

taglines: Every lane, every limit, in view
Flag the overflow, keep the flow
boilerplate: Lanewise is a project tool that splits kanban boards into team swimlanes with work-in-progress limits, so teams can see where work is piling up.

microcopy.success: Card moved to Doing. That lane has 3 of 4.
microcopy.error: Doing is over its limit by 1. You can still drop the card.
microcopy.empty: No cards in this cell. Add one with the plus button.

logo.note: Stacked lanes echo a board of swimlanes and cards.
